pages.text: You do not need anything exotic to start, but a few early items make a big difference:

$(li)An $(l)iron weapon from a family you like$(): a longsword for a safe all-rounder, a spear for reach, a rapier for speed. See $(l:combat/families_light)combat/families_light$(/l).$(li)A $(l)shield$(). Many bosses telegraph heavy blows you can block.$(li)$(l)Wooden or bone armour$() ($(l:armour/immersive_early)armour/immersive_early$(/l)) before you have iron.

$(li)A $(l)backpack$() ($(l:systems/backpacks)systems/backpacks$(/l)): more room for loot on long trips.$(li)An $(l:places/finding)Explorer's Compass$(/l) to point at a structure you want to visit.$(li)A $(l)cooking pot$() ($(l:systems/cooking)systems/cooking$(/l)): hearty meals heal and keep you fed longer than raw food.
Accessories ($(l:armour/accessories)armour/accessories$(/l)) come from chests and camps, not crafting, so open every chest you find.
